The bridge echoes authority_id and answers authorized=false for any authority_id other than its configured DID.
B2 git.commit.sign -> authorized iff entity_id (a did:key) is a CURRENT key of a registered person with at least one endorsed email, any tier (same eligibility as patatt). Retired/revoked keys false. Note: bridge can then say yes where git verify-commit with the default --min-tier contributor export says no (untiered people); accepted by Mark.
B3 Resource is not scoped: the bridge answers for any repository; a yes means 'registry-vouched person', and each consuming project decides if that suffices.
